inclusions_exclusions: Includes substructure, superstructure, MEP, finishes, contractor prelims (10–14%) & OH&P (5–8%); excludes land acquisition, consultant fees (6–10%), municipal plot fees, and 5% UAE VAT.
specification_tier: Tertiary Specialty Hospital & Medical Complex Turnkey (Medical Gas Piping, ISO Class 5 Operating Theatres, Radiation Shielding, Cleanroom HVAC & Redundant Generators)
detailed_inclusions: Includes enabling & shoring works, piling/raft substructure, reinforced concrete or structural steel frame, upper floors, roof waterproofing, external facade/cladding/glazing, internal blockwork/partitions, base-build & fit-out MEP (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, ELV/BMS), vertical transportation (elevators/escalators), internal finishes (unless Shell & Core), contractor preliminaries (10%–14%), and main contractor OH&P (6%–9%).
detailed_exclusions: Excludes land acquisition cost, municipal plot registration/DLD/ADREC fees, off-site utility authority connection charges (DEWA/TAQA/SEWA/EtihadWE infrastructure tariffs), professional consultant design/supervision fees (typically 7%–11% of construction cost), loose tenant furniture/equipment (except hotel FF&E where stated), developer marketing/sales commissions, financing/escrow interest, and 5% UAE VAT.
location_and_emirate_multipliers: Dubai Baseline = 1.00x | Abu Dhabi Island/Offshore = 1.02x–1.05x | Sharjah = 0.84x–0.88x | Ras Al Khaimah = 0.85x–0.92x (1.05x on Al Marjan Ultra-Luxury) | Ajman = 0.78x–0.83x | Umm Al Quwain = 0.78x–0.84x | Fujairah = 0.80x–0.86x
publication_date: Q4 2025 / Q1 2026 (RICS / Turner & Townsend ICMS / Currie & Brown / Kolaboro)
